notes: Chunk B: topics M3.S13.T13 to M3.S19.T19 (22 items). Decisions follow the v3 rules and the 23 Nov 2026 user decisions (own diagram even where a teaching image shows the figure; book mistakes corrected in the spec; LP text issues only listed).
Symmetry facts of every drawn shape (border shapes 1-19, designs of squares and triangles, the 4-square shape) were checked by computation on the exact coordinates in the specs.
See map/notes_B.md for borderline calls and LP text issues.

figure_inventory.description: Square of 4 equal cells in a 2 x 2 grid: top-left light green, top-right pink, bottom-left pink, bottom-right light green (checked on the page picture: correct).

Square with thick black border and 4 dashed grey lines through the centre (vertical, horizontal, both diagonals) cutting it into 8 uncoloured triangles; a small grey dot at the centre (checked on the page picture: correct).
Second use of the green-pink 2 x 2 square: it is the left design of the question "Do these designs have reflection symmetry also?".
Second use of the 8-triangle square: coloured orange and blue one after the other (the solution of the colouring question) it is the right design of "Do these designs have reflection symmetry also?".

Eight loose cut-out pieces on the page: 4 tan equilateral triangles and 4 blue squares, tilted at different angles, side length equal (checked on the page picture: correct). Illustrates the material only.

Four blue squares in a 2 x 2 block with a tan triangle at the left end and one at the right end of each row (4 triangles, each with its base on the block and its point away). Checked on the page picture: correct; the triangles are about one square side high.

Two tiles tagged Wooden Block and Print: a photograph of a carved block with two stacked diamond motifs and the same design printed in black on cloth (checked on the page picture: correct). Introduces block printing; no question uses it.

Five block photographs (i) paisley/drop, (ii) lotus, (iii) rosette, (iv) fan, (v) tall block with a plant, and five half prints (a) blue right half of a rosette, (b) green left half of a plant, (c) teal right half of a drop, (d) yellow left half of a lotus, (e) red left half of a fan; a line joins (iv) to (e). Checked on the page picture: the half sides (right for a and c, left for b, d, e) are correct.

Wooden block (a leaf-shaped block) and its print A: 4 leaf motifs round the middle at quarter turns, with the sentence about 1/4 turn already filled in (checked on the page picture: correct). No LP item asks about design A (the LP worked example M3.S15.T15.C47 uses a two-stamp flower instead).

Design B: 4 purple heart-shaped lobes, one up, one down, one left, one right, pointed ends meeting at the middle, with a dashed vertical and a dashed horizontal line through the middle (checked on the page picture: correct).

CORRECTED: the 19 shapes round the page border, numbered 1 to 19 (the LP numbering) from the top-left corner. Base description checked shape by shape against the page picture. Corrections: shape 3 is NOT a regular hexagon: it is a six-sided shape about as tall as it is wide (corners (1,0), (0.5,1), (-0.5,1), (-1,0), (-0.5,-1), (0.5,-1)), with 2 lines of symmetry and a 1/2 turn; shape 7 is a rhombus whose long diagonal is tilted about 9 degrees (not untilted); shape 9 is a ring of 10 triangular tips in 5 mirror pairs (pair gap about 27 degrees, between pairs about 45 degrees), drawn slightly uneven; shape 4 has its top arm slightly shorter than the other two (drawn equal here, as the LP treats it); shape 16 is two equal ISOSCELES triangles (apex angle about 55 degrees) meeting at their apex along one common axis, so it has 2 lines of symmetry and a 1/2 turn; shape 14 has a grey triangle about 8 percent larger than the yellow one. Layout drawn here is a 7 x 5 ring instead of the page layout; order and symmetry facts are unchanged.

Picture (a): three okra pods, one cut piece with a five-sided cross-section, and two flower-like prints (about 7 pentagon stamps each) on a stem with two leaves (checked on the page picture: correct). Illustrates an open project.

Picture (b): three potatoes with striped cut faces and six oval prints in a 2 x 3 chessboard-like arrangement, 3 orange-yellow and 3 blue (checked on the page picture: correct). Illustrates an open project.
